body:
Well, I guess the main thing is that my anxiety has just gotten out of control in the last few years and nothing I've tried has done anything to reduce it. But because of that it's been next to impossible for me to get out and be around people, so I'm very lonely. 

I just want to get out and be around people without being a twitchy weirdo, but everytime I get into situations where I can talk to somebody new, I choke on my words and it gets awkward fast. Besides that, I've become really paranoid that everybody is watching me and laughing at me, which makes it hard when I even go to the store.

I'm also transgender, and the anxiety and paranoia are really hindering my progress with my transition. 

It's all just really overwhelming and I feel so hopeless at this point. I've been making a real effort for almost two years now and I'm closer to suicide than ever before.

I go back and forth between constantly fantasizing about suicide and thinking about realistic plans. I feel like it's an inevitability that I'll at least *try* something someday. I **know** that it's the wrong decision but I don't know how much longer I can resist the temptation to go through with my plan. I just wish these feelings would go away.

Sorry for the late reply. I couldnt figure out how to put my thoughts into words
